newsitem.title: USA: SoCalGas disputes Edison market power allegations.
newsitem.headline: SoCalGas disputes Edison market power allegations.

text.p: Southern California Gas Co (SoCalGas), the main subsidiary of Pacific Enterprises, on Monday urged federal regulators to reject complaints of undue market power by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co.

Edison last month filed a complaint with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) that SoCalGas holds too much market power over interstate natural gas pipelines and is able to inflate gas prices in southern California.

SoCalGas said Monday the allegations were designed to derail the proposed Pacific Enterprises-Enova Corp merger and to eliminate any possible competition before electric industry restructuring is launched in California.
In its response, SoCalGas said the complaint was without merit and noted that Edison failed to cite any specific violations of FERC orders or regulations because no such violations have occurred.
SoCalGas' filing asks the FERC to dismiss the Edison case as being without merit, since no FERC or California Public Utility Commission rules have been violated.
